records.title: 10-Q
records.text: The increase in revenue was driven primarily by increased activity in the OFS and DS segments, partially offset by lower volume in the TPS and OFE segments.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Equipment orders were up $0.5 billion, or 20%, and service orders were up $0.2 billion, or 7%.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: However, while the current price environment is attractive for new projects, this is also a pivotal time for the industry, with price-related demand destruction occurring in some markets and LNG developers facing inflationary pressures and a higher cost of capital for new projects.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: This situation has resulted in record high LNG prices but has also slowed down switching from coal-to-gas in some developing countries.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Operating income in the third quarter of 2022 was $269 million compared to $378 million in the third quarter of 2021.
